title: pteris pedata
intro: Pteris pedata, commonly known as the Chinese brake fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pteris pedata include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
